{{Top|leg}}
'''''T-DP''''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]] that tried to ferry [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to parked [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] to defend a foothold against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack from the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] ''[[Compton]]''. The tug was destroyed before it could deliver pilots to the A-wings.
